response.answer: Expected bonding yields are typically 95% or higher. Alignment tolerances are within 10 microns. Optical loss due to misalignment is minimal below 0.1 dB. Accelerated reliability tests include thermal cycling and vibration testing, with pass criteria at 1000 cycles and 100 hours, respectively.

results.title: Integrated Optics: Devices, Materials, and Technologies XXX
results.content: In this paper, recent development on the InP membrane nanophotonics technology will be reviewed, with a focus on novel material integration to achieve new functionalities, such as high speed modulation, optical circulator, optical memory as well as photonic neural network. We have recently shown that in addition to being excellent materials for bulk optic applications such as windows and lenses, CHIPs are excellent materials for integrated photonics, as their high refractive indices provide for compact components such as microring resonators, while their low losses enable high levels of integration. The demonstrated second-order nonlinear optical performance on a wafer-scale, CMOS-compatible AlN photonics platform highlights its strong potential for integrated frequency-comb generation and applications in AR/VR, biosensing, and quantum photonics. Integration of efficient electro-optic phase shifters in the C-band on a low loss SiN platform will relax design and performance constraints on applications requiring many phase shifters, including optical phased arrays, photonic integrated channelizers, and dynamic polarization controllers.
